objections.id: hole candidate including files the worker
objections.text: …hole candidate, including files the worker created.” → Add a runCandidate/workflow regression using an untracked created file; capture the audit request and reviewer prompt/packet, and assert both contain its new-file patch and content.

objections.id: persist or otherwise bind the candidate
objections.text: … Persist or otherwise bind the candidate’s creation/base revision when the worktree is made, then construct the tracked portion against that immutable base rather than current HEAD. Preserve the required direct-Git, non-mutating behavior.

objections.id: sport safe lossless representation for diff
objections.text: …sport-safe, lossless representation for diff evidence across the MCP boundary, or ensure CandidateDiff emits an ASCII-safe patch representation for every byte sequence sent through JSON without changing the reviewer-visible patch semantics.
